records.title: Low Fly Technique
records.header: DANCE 376 Low Fly Technique (2/3, max. 24)
records.text: DANCE 376 Low Fly Technique (2/3, max. 24) Students learn low fly technique, a rope-and-harness-based component of vertical dance that integrates ground-based movement with near-ground suspension using rock-climbing gear. Through experimentation, play, and shared practice, students explore their relationships with the floor, air, and with gravity - discovering new pathways for momentum, weight, orientation, and flight.
